messages:
Alice M: Kicking off a config-only change for routing limits + batching for midday traffic. Canaries start in 5m. Change window: 12:30–13:30 UTC. Please watch p99 and error-rate :eyes:
Bob K: ack. config diff is tiny — lowering per-tenant in-flight from 20 -> 12, batch_max_latency 40ms -> 30ms, routing fallback weight to spare-capacity 0.15 -> 0.25.
Carol R: throwing the config snippet here. quick review?
```yaml
routing_policy:
  spare_capacity_weight: 0.25
limits:
  per_tenant_in_flight: 12
timeouts:
  generation_timeout_ms: 60000
batching:
  max_batch_latency_ms: 30
  prefer_small_batches: true
```
Bob K: lgtm on the values. note: lowering in_flight may increase queuing — watch tail latency for small tenants.
deploy-bot: Canary batch deploy started for config set `cfg-2024-05-midday-slim-1` -> 10% traffic. Jobs: kickoff -> ok, healthchecks -> running. :rocket:
Alice M: Primary metrics to watch: p99 latency, 5m rolling error-rate, successful_kv_cache_hits, and any increase in long queue durations. If error-rate >2% for 5m OR p99 > 600ms for 3m we roll back.
Dan S: adding a soft pin to the model routing so we don't switch model variants during canary: `pin.routing=stable-v2`. Also turning up observability: trace sampling -> 25% for this canary.
Carol R: Ops checklist: notify customer-facing if we see >1% user-visible errors. Metrics dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/abc123 (limited to infra).
eng-oncall: Oncall noted. I'll alert at the 2% threshold and be ready for rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 10% -> 35% after 9m. Healthchecks: OK. No errors detected.
Alice M: good. Let's hold at 35% for 10m then decide. People in this thread, please flag any unexpected spikes. :thumbsup:
Bob K: saw a small bump in small-tenant queue length ~2m ago, p95 up 80ms but p99 stable. continuing to monitor.
Carol R: nothing from synthetic tests.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 70% complete.
Alice M: ramping to full at 70 -> 100 only if stable for 10m. Rollback plan: deploy-bot rollback to previous config `cfg-2024-05-stable` and immediate pin reversal. Manual override steps in runbook.
Dan S: noted. I'll be ready to execute rollback if oncall triggers.
eng-oncall: No threshold breaches. Holding for final 10m then we can finish.
Alice M: thanks everyone — if all good I'll finalize release notes and mark the change window closed at 13:30 UTC.
Bob K: small post-check: open a follow-up ticket to evaluate if `prefer_small_batches` creates fragmentation; label with `perf-investigate`.
Carol R: added ticket #INV-789.
Alice M: :tada: Closing thread when finished.
